extension.description: The Nightcity skin in a quiet look: a centred spotlight, posters in calm rows, a soft glow on focus, colour themes and rounded buttons, with online movie and TV data from TMDb Helper.

Der Nightcity-Skin in ruhigem Look: ein mittiges Spotlight, Poster in ruhigen Reihen, ein sanftes Leuchten im Fokus, Farbschemata und runde Schaltflächen, mit Online-Daten zu Filmen und Serien von TMDb Helper.

Le skin Nightcity dans un style apaisé : une mise en avant centrée, des affiches en lignes sobres, une douce lueur sur la sélection, des thèmes de couleur et des boutons arrondis, avec les données en ligne des films et séries de TMDb Helper.

El skin Nightcity con un aspecto sereno: un destacado centrado, pósteres en filas tranquilas, un brillo suave en el foco, temas de color y botones redondeados, con datos en línea de películas y series de TMDb Helper.

La skin Nightcity in un aspetto sobrio: una vetrina centrata, locandine in righe ordinate, un leggero bagliore sul focus, temi di colore e pulsanti arrotondati, con dati online su film e serie TV da TMDb Helper.

A skin Nightcity em um visual sereno: um destaque centralizado, pôsteres em linhas tranquilas, um brilho suave no foco, temas de cores e botões arredondados, com dados online de filmes e séries do TMDb Helper.

Skórka Nightcity w spokojnym wydaniu: wyśrodkowana sekcja wyróżnionych, plakaty w spokojnych rzędach, delikatna poświata na zaznaczeniu, motywy kolorów i zaokrąglone przyciski, z danymi online o filmach i serialach z TMDb Helper.
Nightcityスキンを静かな外観にしたものです。中央のスポットライト、静かに並ぶポスター、フォーカス時のやわらかな光、カラーテーマ、角の丸いボタンを備え、TMDb Helperによるムービーとテレビ番組のオンライン情報も表示します。

De Nightcity-skin in een rustige look: een gecentreerde spotlight, posters in rustige rijen, een zachte gloed bij focus, kleurthema's en afgeronde knoppen, met online film- en seriegegevens van TMDb Helper.
Nightcity-skalet i en lugn stil: en centrerad spotlight, affischer i lugna rader, ett mjukt sken vid fokus, färgteman och rundade knappar, med onlinedata om filmer och serier från TMDb Helper.
Nightcity-skinnet i et roligt look: et centreret spotlight, plakater i rolige rækker, et blødt skær ved fokus, farvetemaer og afrundede knapper, med onlinedata om film og serier fra TMDb Helper.

Nightcity-ulkoasu hillityssä asussa: keskitetty spotlight, julisteet rauhallisissa riveissä, pehmeä hehku kohdistuksessa, väriteemat ja pyöristetyt painikkeet sekä elokuvien ja sarjojen verkkotiedot TMDb Helperistä.
Vzhled Nightcity v tichém pojetí: výběr uprostřed, plakáty v klidných řadách, jemná záře na fokusu, barevné motivy a zaoblená tlačítka, s online údaji o filmech a seriálech z TMDb Helper.
Vzhľad Nightcity v tichom poňatí: výber v strede, plagáty v pokojných radoch, jemná žiara na fokuse, farebné motívy a zaoblené tlačidlá, s online údajmi o filmoch a seriáloch z TMDb Helper.

A Nightcity felszín csendes kiadásban: középre igazított kiemeltek, poszterek nyugodt sorokban, lágy ragyogás a fókuszon, színtémák és lekerekített gombok, a TMDb Helper online film- és sorozatadataival.

Nightcity dış görünümünün sakin hali: ortalanmış vitrin, sakin sıralarda afişler, odakta yumuşak bir parıltı, renk temaları ve yuvarlatılmış düğmeler, TMDb Helper'dan çevrimiçi film ve dizi bilgileriyle.
Presvlaka Nightcity u tihom izgledu: centrirano istaknuto, posteri u mirnim redovima, blagi sjaj na fokusu, teme boja i zaobljeni gumbi, s mrežnim podacima o filmovima i serijama iz TMDb Helpera.

Nightcity apvalkalas tyliu stiliumi: centruoti akcentai, plakatai ramiose eilėse, švelnus švytėjimas ant fokuso, spalvų temos ir suapvalinti mygtukai, su TMDb Helper internetiniais filmų ir serialų duomenimis.
Nightcity rüü vaikses kuues: keskele paigutatud esiletõst, plakatid rahulikes ridades, pehme kuma fookusel, värviteemad ja ümarad nupud, TMDb Helperi võrguandmetega filmide ja sarjade kohta.

Nightcity-skinnið í rólegu útliti: miðjað kastljós, veggspjöld í rólegum röðum, mjúkur ljómi á virkni, litaþemu og ávalir hnappar, með upplýsingum á netinu um kvikmyndir og þáttaraðir frá TMDb Helper.

Die Nightcity-oortreksel in 'n stil voorkoms: 'n gesentreerde kollig, plakkate in rustige rye, 'n sagte gloed op die fokus, kleurtemas en geronde knoppies, met aanlyn film- en reeksdata van TMDb Helper.

L'aparença Nightcity amb un estil serè: un destacat centrat, pòsters en files tranquil·les, una brillantor suau en el focus, temes de color i botons arrodonits, amb dades en línia de pel·lícules i sèries de TMDb Helper.

Skin Nightcity dalam tampilan tenang: sorotan di tengah, poster dalam baris yang rapi, cahaya lembut pada fokus, tema warna, dan tombol membulat, dengan data film dan acara TV daring dari TMDb Helper.

La máscara Nightcity con un aspecto sereno: un destacado centrado, pósteres en filas tranquilas, un brillo suave en el foco, temas de color y botones redondeados, con datos en línea de películas y series de TMDb Helper.
Обложка Nightcity в тихом облике: витрина по центру, постеры в спокойных рядах, мягкое свечение на фокусе, цветовые темы и скруглённые кнопки, с онлайн-данными о фильмах и сериалах из TMDb Helper.
Обкладинка Nightcity в тихому вигляді: вітрина по центру, постери в спокійних рядах, м'яке сяйво на фокусі, колірні теми та заокруглені кнопки, з онлайн-даними про фільми та серіали з TMDb Helper.
Абалонка Nightcity у ціхім выглядзе: вітрына па цэнтры, постэры ў спакойных радах, мяккае ззянне на фокусе, каляровыя тэмы і закругленыя кнопкі, з анлайн-данымі пра фільмы і серыялы з TMDb Helper.
Nightcity 스킨의 차분한 버전: 가운데 스포트라이트, 차분하게 늘어선 포스터, 포커스의 부드러운 빛, 색상 테마와 둥근 버튼, 그리고 TMDb Helper의 영화와 TV 쇼 온라인 정보.
安静风格的 Nightcity 皮肤：居中的精选、整齐排列的海报、焦点上的柔和光晕、配色主题和圆角按钮，并通过 TMDb Helper 提供电影和电视剧的在线资料。
安靜風格的 Nightcity 面板：置中的精選、整齊排列的海報、焦點上的柔和光暈、配色主題與圓角按鈕，並透過 TMDb Helper 提供電影與影集的線上資料。
extension.news: 0.1.4 - The library list shows the poster of the focused title under its title, the details of each row as tags, and for movies runtime, resolution and audio channels until you pick others. Codec and channels, resolution and HDR are tags of their own.[CR]The library filter has a Clear button next to OK.[CR]Holding OK on Movies or Shows in the menu opens the whole library; holding Back in the settings goes back to where you opened them.[CR]The key hints are arrows at the edge they point to: Up at the top, Left along the left edge, Down and OK in the footer, and the same wherever the focus is on a page. The add-on browser and the file manager show the way back.[CR]Now also in Dutch, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Afrikaans, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Croatian, Lithuanian, Estonian, Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Turkish, Indonesian, Catalan, Mexican Spanish, Korean and Chinese (simplified and traditional): machine-translated, corrections are welcome. For Korean and Chinese choose the font Arial, as for Japanese.[CR]0.1.3 - All movies and all shows can be shown as a list: a Details button picks what a row shows (year, runtime, rating, resolution, HDR, audio; for shows seasons, episodes, studio), sorting adds runtime, and a filter narrows the list by genre, resolution, HDR, audio format, channels and studio. The music library has a genre filter.[CR]On Deck: continue watching and next up in one row, now the first row of home and shows.[CR]A still spotlight shows the title Down would land on, with its buttons; a spotlight switched off is gone. Movies have their own spotlight interval.[CR]Trailers come from IMDb in the best quality, without the YouTube add-on.[CR]The home page can be hidden like the other pages; the Home key goes to the first page shown.[CR]The current episode of an episode page has the focus frame without the glow.[CR]The filter dialogs have one OK, Left goes up a level, Right enters a group.[CR]Back held in the player's chapter and cast rows goes back to the controls.[CR]Icons keep their shape on screens that are not 16:9.[CR]The row Unwatched is gone: new movies and new episodes have it as option, and set rows move over by themselves.[CR]The small glitches are down to the loading screen, without a setting.[CR]0.1.2 - Confuse now speaks German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Japanese. For Japanese choose the font Arial under Settings, Interface, Skin, Fonts: it is Kodi's own font with Japanese letters.[CR]Small glitches: now and then the loading spinner sticks or runs backwards, the logo shivers, the spotlight tears for a blink and some titles twitch when they get the focus. The switch is under Appearance in the skin settings.[CR]The buttons of an info page have room for every language: the last one was cut off in German.[CR]0.1.1 - A new look for Home: the tabs in the middle, the spotlight as a large sharp picture, continue and next up as wide cards with the art of the film or show, posters in every other row.[CR]A logo of its own, also as the icon, and a quiet loading page with the logo and a spinner.[CR]The fades over the spotlight and the player controls are lighter, a focused card glows, and the glow of a focused tab is no longer cut off.[CR]The subtitle and audio delay can be set again in the player.[CR]0.1.0 - First version of Confuse: the Nightcity skin in a calm look with a glowing ember focus and colour themes.
